Sources used by this tool
Points: the Munitorum Field Manual v1.6 (mfm.warhammer-community.com), extracted on 14 October 2026 from its units, detachments and enhancements tables. It replaces the earlier V2 table.

Detachment costs: Guardians of the Throne 3 DP, every other detachment 1 DP. A budget of 3 DP is confirmed: Guardians of the Throne is taken alone, otherwise up to 3 other detachments. Only one Unique Shield Host per army.

Later copies cost more (price by order of the unit in the army list, per datasheet): Shield-Captain on foot, Allarus, Jetbike and Gyrfalcon +20 from the 2nd; Wardens, Telemon and Ares Gunship +30 from the 2nd; Orion Assault Dropship +50 from the 2nd; Vertus Praetors +20 from the 2nd; Blade Champion +20 from the 3rd; Allarus Custodians, Aquilon Terminators (each weapon option counts separately), Venatari Lances, Contemptor-Galatus, Contemptor-Achillus, Caladius and Annihilator +30 from the 3rd; Venatari Kinetic Destroyers +25 from the 3rd; Coronus +20 from the 3rd; Sentinel Guard and Custodian Guard +30 from the 4th; Anathema Psykana Rhino +10 from the 4th.
Enhancement and Upgrade points: the same Munitorum Field Manual (29 items, e.g. Radiant Mantle 40, Huntress’ Eye 10). Leonine Ferocity (20 pts) is the name used by the points table and the codex.
Detachments, rules, enhancements and stratagems: the 11th edition codex (pages 91 to 105). Stats: datasheets.
Anathema Psykana (page 91): units are included without the ADEPTUS CUSTODES keyword and are never Warlord, except with Null Maiden Vigil.
assume
Assumptions made by the tool
A later copy surcharge also applies to the copies after it (4th, 5th…). The Munitorum Field Manual lists open-ended tiers ("3rd + units"), which this reproduces.
Each datasheet counts its own copies. Venatari with pistols and with lances are two separate datasheets, as are Caladius and Annihilator, and Aquilon Terminators with gauntlets or with talons.

Ares Gunship and Orion Assault Dropship are in the points table but their datasheets are not in this site’s data yet: they can be added to a roster at their points, with no datasheet page, no damage figures and no keywords beyond Adeptus Custodes and Vehicle.

The Munitorum Field Manual also lists Legends units (Aleya, Valerian, Venerable Contemptor Dreadnought, Venerable Land Raider, Custodian Guard with Adrasite or Pyrithite Spears, Sagittarum Custodians). They are not in the builder.

Wargear options (Wargear section of each unit) come from the datasheets, have no points cost except the Shield-Captain’s Praesidium Shield (25 pts), and are not otherwise restricted. Enhancements are limited to Characters, except Upgrades, which target units. Each can be taken once per army. The rule of 3 copies and any cap on the number of enhancements are not applied.

Not yet confirmed, so not calculated

Praesidium Shield: the points table lists a Praesidium Shield equipment option at 25 pts for the Shield-Captain. The builder charges it whenever the Shield-Captain carries the shield (Pyrithite Spear + Praesidium Shield, which is the default, and Eternity-pattern Paragon Blade); the Castellan Axe and Guardian Spear replace the shield, so they cost nothing extra.
Leader and support links in the points table (which Characters can lead which units) are not enforced by the builder.
Points limits (Combat Patrol 500, Incursion 1000, Strike Force 2000, Onslaught 3000): the tool’s choice, adjustable by hand.
Not applied: rule of 3 copies, maximum number of enhancements, transport restrictions. Not covered by the sources used.
Eagle’s Eye enhancement wording: to be verified against the codex.
